tw-mi-big-sable-1731-spanish-coin.st: The Grand Rapids Press of 14 Jun 1930 reports a single 1731 Spanish coin found in the beach sand by a coast guard keeper, already picked up; the site is inside Ludington State Park.

tw-wi-wisconsin-mouth-coins-1887.st: Conflict: the Stevens Point Journal of 30 Apr 1887 (quoting the Grand Rapids, Wis., Tribune) puts the silver find at Portage, not at the confluence, and the coins were recovered.
src: Stevens Point Journal, 30 Apr 1887, p. 1 (quoting the Grand Rapids Tribune)
